description: Common schema for the integrated InP dataset. Stacks DD InP subset (132 rows from data/from_dd/inp_subset.csv) and Cossairt raw dataset (220 entries from data/from_cossairt/dataset_InP_raw.csv) on cross-comparable columns. Source-specific columns are preserved as separate fields filled with empty string for non-applicable rows.

filter_rules.cossairt_filter: all 220 entries from dataset_InP_raw.csv (GitHub Cossairt-Lab/Indium-Phosphide master, SHA-256 verified MIT)

overlap_definition: 10 papers in DD ∩ Cossairt, derived from the user's prior paper-level matching (matched_to_L_series == 'yes' in cossairt_reference_master_paper_level.csv).

T_growth_C.notes: primary input for cross-source feature comparison

time_min.notes: growth-time definition consistency to verify in Phase C.1

dd_only_columns: caution_count (DD audit-load metric, do not use as ML target)
cossairt_only_columns: diameter_nm (QD diameter, nm; DD does not report size)

unit_normalization_rules.T_growth_C: kept as °C (no conversion); Cossairt temp_c and DD T_growth_C are both °C per audit
unit_normalization_rules.time_min: kept as min (no conversion); both sources report minutes
unit_normalization_rules.emission_nm: kept as nm (no conversion); both sources report PL/emission peak in nm
unit_normalization_rules.QY_percent: DD reports QY in % (0-100); Cossairt does not provide QY
unit_normalization_rules.FWHM_nm: DD reports FWHM in nm; Cossairt does not provide FWHM

missing_value_convention: empty string "" for blank; never NaN/None/NULL in CSV
